summary: [spec fidelity] The approved brief's F3 failure path says writing a Run the store already holds 'with other content' is 'rejected as now', but persist_idempotent (moved unchanged from 0.38, crates/canon-cli/src/tiers.rs:528) only swallows DuplicatePath, which the git tier raises for a byte-identical path; other content hashes to another path and is stored as a new version the read fold ranks. Confirmed black-box on a git-routed repo: dispatch begin then end leaves two kind=run objects and one folded row (a second end is DISPATCH_CONFLICT ALREADY_ENDED from the manifest, not from the tier). The scenario text and the code agree with each other and with 0.38; the brief wording is wrong, so the owner should amend the brief or confirm 'new version' is the intended contract. Blast radius: nothing else changed; the sqlite hot tier is not exercised by this test.
